title: Proposal:  measurement or number or quantity or num semantic HTML tag

labels.name: needs implementer interest
labels.description: Moving the issue forward requires implementers to express interest

body:
This would be similar in purpose and functionality to the [time(date)](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/time) tag, but for numbers.

This would be a declarative HTML wrapper around [Intl.NumberFormat](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Intl/NumberFormat).

What is displayed to the user would be number.localeString() if no other attributes listed below are specified.  Otherwise Intl.NumberFormat could be used.

Suggested main attributes:

|Attribute name                                 |Property name    |Notes             
|---------------------------------------|-------------------|---------------------------------
|unit                                                   |unit                    | List from [here](https://github.com/unicode-org/cldr/blob/main/common/validity/unit.xml) 
|type                                                  |type                    |"float", "int", "bigInt", "number" would be the options
|value                                                |value                  |"1.234".  This is how values are passed in.
|lang                                                  |lang                    |"de-DE" (already a global attribute)

I would propose every additional property Intl.NumberFormat recognizes be supported as an attribute (particularly as they move out of experimental status):  numberingsystem, signdisplay, unitdisplay, roundingmode, etc.

This proposal also calls for including this tag in the microdata specification, where the value of the tag is derived from the value attribute/property.
